title: #93 – Daphne Koller: Biomedicine and Machine Learning
summary: Daphne Koller is a professor of computer science at Stanford University, a co-founder of Coursera with Andrew Ng and Founder and CEO of insitro, a company at the intersection of machine learning and biomedicine.
